pages.title: Reweave
pages.text:
**Spindle.** A digital loom (AE2, with a Knot in the controller and a Braid in the assembler). A Gate Drum. The March, and a March stone from it.\
Nine seated, one stone, one right-click: the Fragment. Seat it. The cut closes above your pad.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text: Seat all nine tokens. Right-click the Post with March Stone for a **Spindle Loom Fragment**, then right-click again holding the Fragment. Your Clowder's Strand of the Fray closes.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
